Priya Rao: Quick heads-up — Riverline usage down ~68% M/M. Admin contact (Raj) left last Friday and we got a procurement cc from a new contact. Seeing traces of a competitor POC mentioned in their email. :warning:
Jon Kim: Ugh. Do we have seat activity by API key or route? any pattern (embeddings vs. chat)? :eyes:
Maya Chen: I pulled the route-level heatmap — most calls were embeddings and a couple of batch reranks. Last recorded token activity 2026-03-05. No spikes in error rates.
Priya Rao: I just emailed Raj and looped in the new procurement alias. No reply yet. Putting this on triage — looks like a stakeholder handoff + competitive eval.
Jon Kim: I'll ping the AE and ask for any recent exec touchpoints. If they're evaluating alternatives, we should surface usage delta + value metrics ASAP.
Maya Chen: Attaching short log snippet I ran locally:
```
# embeddings usage by key
key: app-prod-rl-03 hits: 125 -> 39 (30d)
route: /v1/embeddings model: open-embed-16k
most_active_user: ops@riverline.com
```
Priya Rao: Good — can we prepare a 1-pager showing: 1) monthly token delta 2) top affected flows 3) recommended short-term plays (pilot extension, SKUs, expedited onboarding help)?
Jon Kim: On it. Suggest we offer a 30-day pilot discount + a short runbook for migrating their competitor model outputs back into our inference (stickiness play). Want me to draft outreach?
Maya Chen: Also recommend enabling live session with solutions eng to walk their ML lead through latency/cost comparisons. That often surfaces hidden blockers.
Priya Rao: Yes. Action items: Jon draft outreach + pricing tweak, Maya prepare runbook + diff table, I'll keep outreach to procurement and try to re-establish contact with Raj. If no reply by EOD tomorrow, escalate to CS Lead.
CS Bot: Reminder set: follow-up in 24h (thread pinned).
Jon Kim: Drafted outreach, sending now — cc'ing Maya. Using subject: "Quick check: Riverline — usage & pilot options". I'll paste copy in thread for review.
Priya Rao: Thanks — drop the copy here and I’ll add the exec touch.
Maya Chen: I'll get the runbook and cost delta table by EOD.
Priya Rao: Great. Keeping this as high-priority renewal-watch. :white_check_mark:
